_comment: Recorded baselines for scripts/do-not-break-gates.js. Ratcheted DOWN by the phase that improves a number, never up to make a red gate green. Regenerate with --record only as a deliberate re-baselining act, and say so in the commit message.

suite.comment: P0.1 is the floor every later phase compares against. postP0 records where phase P0 left the suite. Count with scripts/test-assertion-count.js so the five summary formats are normalised the same way every time.

postP0.note: includes 3 files and 120 assertions from the concurrent P6 and P8 tracks (codex-paths 22, codex-state-db 64, vt-sidecar 34); P0 itself contributed notion-token-parity 13 and do-not-break-gates 17

postP1.note: P1 added and removed zero assertions; it retargeted 13 existing ones across five files (SE-1, SE-4, SE-7, SE-11). The +2 against postP0-plus-drift comes from the concurrent P8 track (codex-state-db 64 to 66).

postP2.note: P2 added, removed and retargeted ZERO assertions. No sanctioned test edit was needed: every P2 change was a rule body, and the anchors the suite reads (selectors, single-line rules, cachebusters, the two pinned focus rules, the frozen provider-tab template) were all preserved. The count is identical to postP1 because the concurrent tracks did not add a file between the two runs.

G3.name: [hidden] guard rules across the four stylesheets

G4.name: Catppuccin var() consumption outside the palette blocks

G12a.name: em dash and horizontal bar occurrences in the scanned trees

G12b.name: em dashes and prose double hyphens in lines added since the baseline commit
